upsertPapers.title: A Simple (1−ε)-Approximation Semi-Streaming Algorithm for Maximum (Weighted) Matching
upsertPapers.label: Assadi ’25

upsertSlices.label: Streaming; insertion-only, weighted multiple passes
upsertSlices.task: Output near-optimal matching edges by total positive integer weight
assumptions: Arbitrary-order insertion-only stream; multiple passes over the input.
General graph with positive integer edge weights.
Output is an explicit matching of edges with weight at least (1−ε)OPTweight.
Working memory is O(n log² n/ε) bits; semi-streaming for fixed ε.
This is an approximation guarantee with respect to total matching weight, not only cardinality.

parameters.epsilon: Approximation error; retained in pass and memory formulas

results.notes: Positive integer weights; unit weights give cardinality. Different ε conventions are retained; no numerical quality coordinate is assigned. Memory O(n log² n/ε) bits; success ≥1−exp(−Θ(n)). No comparable insertion-only multipass lower bound was verified in this source set. Lower bounds for streams with deletions are not transferred to this insertion-only contract.
